info.title: Cardomancer Card Sorter API
info.description: HTTP API for the Cardomancer Card Sorter. Auto-generated from `web_server.py` by `tools/generate_openapi.py`. Most endpoints accept and return JSON. POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH endpoints are gated by the CSRF Origin / Referer / X-Requested-With check (see the `csrf_failed` response below). Socket.IO traffic is separate and not covered here.

host.description: Hostname or LAN IP of the kiosk.

GenericObject.description: Placeholder schema — see route-specific docs or inspect the view function. Hand-annotated schemas live in docs/openapi-overlay.yaml.

error.description: Stable machine-readable code. See static/errors.json for the user-facing copy mapping.

WorkerState.description: Cardomancer worker state machine — see web_worker.STATES.

config.description: Filename of a sort preset under sort_configs/, OR an inline config_lines text body. The worker accepts either.

continuous.description: If true, the worker re-enqueues a new detect-and-sort cycle after every drop until the source bin is empty or the operator pauses.

notes.description: Free-text operator notes; persisted to sessions.notes.

config_text.description: Inline config_lines body. Sent when the operator starts from an unsaved preset edit. Stored in sessions.config_text so power-loss-resume can rehydrate.

query.description: Compiled query that was actually applied (echoed back).

error.description: Query parse error, if any. Present only on 400.

builtin.description: True for shipped presets (color.txt etc.) — these can't be overwritten or deleted by the operator.

builtins.description: Filenames that are shipped as built-in presets.

cron.description: Cron expression or shorthand (e.g. 'weekly') controlling automatic refresh cadence.

QueuedResponse.description: Generic ack for fire-and-forget worker-enqueue endpoints. The actual result arrives later as a Socket.IO event.

CSRFFailed.description: Cross-site request blocked. The Origin/Referer did not match the kiosk host and the `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest` header was absent.

example.message: This request was blocked because it did not come from the Cardomancer UI. Reload the page and try again.

Crucial: this must NOT go through the worker queue. The worker thread
    is busy running the sweep, so any queued cancel would only execute
    AFTER the sweep finishes, defeating the whole point. Instead we set
    the calibrator's cancel flag directly (it's just a bool) and also
    call the worker's abort helper so _cmd_new_hardware_setup knows to
    stop before proceeding into the probe phase.

get.summary: Live status of any in-flight calibration sweep.
get.description:
The old ``calibrator.get_status()`` shape (running/progress/message/
    bins_found/discovered) is preserved for backward compatibility. The
    wizard consumes the new booleans under ``wizard``:

        wizard.machine_connected    — serial port open
        wizard.camera_connected     — camera device active
        wizard.bin_x_calibrated     — ArUco sweep has run + saved bin X positions
        wizard.bin_z_probed         — every bin has a probe_results entry
        wizard.staging_roi_set      — staging_roi.json exists
        wizard.focus_locked         — camera has locked its autofocus

    Top-level booleans are also mirrored so lightweight consumers can
    read e.g. ``machine_connected`` directly without digging in.

post.summary: Standalone focus-lock endpoint used by the calibration wizard.
post.description:
The existing ``/api/session/confirm-focus`` only works mid-session
    (it releases a worker-side Event waited on by the sort loop). The
    wizard needs to lock focus in isolation, before any session exists,
    so we call ``camera.lock_focus()`` directly. The camera must be
    running for the underlying cv2.VideoCapture property write to take
    effect.

        "use_cache":         true
      }

    Basic lands are excluded from the returned card list regardless of
    printing_mode.

    Returns 200 with:

                            printing_mode}] }

    Returns 400 if deck_url is missing/unparseable or printing_mode invalid.
    Returns 404 if Moxfield returns 404 (deck not found / private).
    Returns 503 if the network request fails (Moxfield unreachable).

        "printing_mode": "any" | "exact"   (default "any"),

    printing_mode.

    here as 401.

    Wishlist API endpoint used:

        cards: [{oracle_id, name, quantity, set, collector_number,

    Returns 400 if username is missing or printing_mode invalid.
    Returns 401 if the wishlist is private (Moxfield returns 401).
    Returns 404 if the user or wishlist does not exist on Moxfield.
    Returns 503 if the network request fails.
